comparators.definition: evict the candidate with the LOWEST S_k (F02 exact, IEEE-754 binary64 evaluated as S*0.99^(i - i_last)+1 per request, decay 0.99 per served step, no sweep); ties: larger F01 (older), then layer ascending, then expert ascending; current-event shield with total fallback
comparators.retrained_or_modified: new in Research 4; definition frozen here, no hyperparameter search

distinction: Historical frozen values are cited only as provenance. Every capture used by a Research 4 decision is a new Research 4 replay value on the frozen splits.

oracle.definition: argine.research.oracle.BeladyGlobal on the same served event list: evict the non-member resident with the farthest next use (never-used-again first); demand admission; not proven optimal for multi-key, two-size events
oracle.role: denominator of the primary endpoint; clairvoyant, never a candidate

reference.definition: b_selected = AgedFrequency, decay 0.999 per access, aging interval 1 (r4.py make_arm('A'))
